text: What if all concrete vanished for five seconds? Bad news. You're standing on it.
Every sidewalk. Every road. Gone. You drop into the dirt. Your car lands next to you.
Your floor? Gone. Only the steel inside is left. Congratulations. You live in a birdcage.
Skyscrapers are steel skeletons now. Nobody is pretending to work anymore.
Hoover Dam. Gone. Lake Mead takes one step forward. The Pantheon stood nineteen hundred years. Hell of a run.
A bus is balancing on bare steel. The driver still won't open the doors.
Concrete is back. Exactly where it was.
You're alive. But your left shoe is part of the sidewalk now. Forever.
What should vanish next? Comment it, or I pick worse.
